publishedfiledetails.title: TUMTaRA Main Menu Buttons
publishedfiledetails.description:
This mod adds buttons to load all TUMTaRA maps [b]with cheats enabled[/b] to your main menu.
It also adds a buttons to open the console and the server browser.
The "blog post" Is now inside the extras menu, because who ever uses that anyways.

This mod technically does not contain the map menu. 
The map menu is shipped with TUMTaRA. 
This mod merely adds the buttons to open that menu.


[h1]I am not going to merge this with Urik's Main Menu Mod.[/h1]
If you want to use urik's menu mod (or any of them), use their mod. 
Load TUMTaRA via console because it is faster anyways.
